sentences.text: The West Bengal Tribal Welfare Scheme for Agricultural Production and Sustainability (WBTWSAPS) aims to enhance agricultural productivity among tribal communities in West Bengal.
The objective of the scheme is to promote sustainable agricultural practices and improve the livelihoods of tribal farmers.
The benefits include financial assistance for agricultural inputs and training on sustainable farming techniques.
Eligibility is primarily for tribal farmers residing in West Bengal.
The application process involves submitting a form to the local agricultural office along with necessary documentation.
The scheme is implemented on an annual basis with specific timelines for application and disbursement of funds.
The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Tribal Development, Government of West Bengal.
Additional details may include specific training programs and workshops organized under the scheme.
